classes.name: Humanoid
classes.note: No climbing, swimming or pathfinding; MoveTo walks a straight line. The state machine runs Running, Jumping, Freefall, Landed, Seated, Physics, Ragdoll, FallingDown, GettingUp, PlatformStanding and Dead; Climbing, Swimming and Flying are never entered.
classes.doc: Makes the model it sits in a character: it walks, jumps, sits, takes damage and dies. The model needs a HumanoidRootPart; the engine moves it with a character controller and poses the limbs through their Motor6D joints.

properties.name: WalkSpeed
properties.doc: How fast it walks, in studs per second.

properties.name: JumpPower
properties.doc: The upward speed of a jump, in studs per second, when UseJumpPower is true.

properties.name: JumpHeight
properties.doc: How high a jump rises, in studs, when UseJumpPower is false.

properties.name: UseJumpPower
properties.doc: Whether jumps use JumpPower (a speed) or JumpHeight (a height).

properties.name: HipHeight
properties.doc: How far the root part floats above the floor, for R15 rigs. R6 rigs stand on their legs and leave it at 0.

properties.name: AutoRotate
properties.doc: Whether the character turns to face the way it walks.

properties.name: MoveDirection
properties.doc: The unit direction it is walking in, or zero when standing.

properties.name: WalkToPoint
properties.doc: Where MoveTo is walking it (relative to WalkToPart when that is set).

properties.name: WalkToPart
properties.doc: The part MoveTo walks it to, or nil.

properties.name: Jump
properties.doc: Set to true to jump; the Humanoid sets it back to false once it jumps.

properties.name: Sit
properties.doc: True while it sits. Setting it false stands it up.

properties.name: SeatPart
properties.doc: The seat it sits in, or nil.
properties.note: Seats are not supported yet; always nil.

properties.name: PlatformStand
properties.doc: When true it stops walking and stands still, limp, in the PlatformStanding state.

properties.name: Health
properties.doc: Its health. At 0 or below it dies.

properties.name: MaxHealth
properties.doc: The most health it can have.

properties.name: BreakJointsOnDeath
properties.doc: Whether its joints break apart when it dies.

properties.name: RequiresNeck
properties.doc: Whether losing the Neck joint kills it.

properties.name: FloorMaterial
properties.doc: The material of the floor it stands on, or Air in the air.

properties.name: RigType
properties.doc: The rig it was built with, R6 or R15.

properties.name: RootPart
properties.doc: The model's HumanoidRootPart, or nil.

properties.name: MaxSlopeAngle
properties.doc: The steepest slope it can walk up, in degrees.
properties.note: Stored; the character controller uses its own slope limit.

properties.name: CameraOffset
properties.doc: Shifts the camera from its subject, in the character's frame.

properties.name: AutomaticScalingEnabled
properties.doc: Whether body scale values resize the rig.
properties.note: Stored; descriptions always rescale the rig.

properties.name: EvaluateStateMachine
properties.doc: Whether the engine runs its state machine. When false, scripts drive the state themselves.

properties.name: DisplayName
properties.doc: The name shown over the character; empty shows the model's name.
properties.note: Stored; no name is drawn over characters yet.

properties.name: DisplayDistanceType
properties.doc: Which distance the name and health display use.
properties.note: Stored; no name or health bar is drawn yet.

properties.name: NameDisplayDistance
properties.doc: The farthest the name is shown from, in studs.
properties.note: Stored; no name is drawn over characters yet.

properties.name: HealthDisplayDistance
properties.doc: The farthest the health bar is shown from, in studs.
properties.note: Stored; no health bar is drawn yet.

properties.name: HealthDisplayType
properties.doc: When the health bar is shown.
properties.note: Stored; no health bar is drawn yet.

properties.name: NameOcclusion
properties.doc: Which names show through walls.
properties.note: Stored; no name is drawn over characters yet.

methods.name: Move
methods.note: relativeToCamera turns the direction by the current camera's yaw only when a camera exists; otherwise it is ignored.
methods.doc: Walks it in a direction until told otherwise; a zero vector stops it. The vertical part is ignored.

methods.name: MoveTo
methods.doc: Walks it in a straight line to a point (relative to part, if given). MoveToFinished fires on arrival, or with false after 8 seconds.

methods.name: TakeDamage
methods.doc: Takes health away, unless the character has a ForceField.

methods.name: ChangeState
methods.doc: Moves it into a state now, unless that state is disabled.

methods.name: SetStateEnabled
methods.doc: Allows or forbids a state. A forbidden state is never entered.

methods.name: LoadAnimation
methods.doc: Loads an animation on the Humanoid's Animator, making one if needed.

methods.name: GetPlayingAnimationTracks
methods.doc: The tracks its Animator is playing.

methods.name: ApplyDescription
methods.note: Applies body colours, scales and animation ids; accessories, clothing and faces are kept on the description but not applied.
methods.doc: Changes the character to match a HumanoidDescription.

methods.name: GetAppliedDescription
methods.doc: A copy of the description last applied.

methods.name: GetLimb
methods.doc: Which limb a part of the R6 rig is, or Unknown.

methods.name: GetBodyPartR15
methods.doc: Which body part of the R15 rig a part is, or Unknown.

methods.name: UnequipTools
methods.doc: Puts any held tool back in the backpack.

methods.name: EquipTool
methods.doc: Makes the character hold a tool.

events.name: Died
events.doc: Its health reached 0, or it lost its neck when RequiresNeck is set.

events.name: StateEnabledChanged
events.doc: SetStateEnabled allowed or forbade a state.

events.name: Running
events.doc: It started or stopped walking, or its speed changed, with its speed along the ground.

events.name: Jumping
events.doc: It entered (true) or left (false) the Jumping state.

events.name: FreeFalling
events.doc: It entered (true) or left (false) the Freefall state.

events.name: Seated
events.doc: It sat down in a seat (true) or got up (false).

events.name: PlatformStanding
events.doc: It entered or left the PlatformStanding state.

events.name: FallingDown
events.doc: It entered or left the FallingDown state.

events.name: GettingUp
events.doc: It entered or left the GettingUp state.

events.name: Ragdoll
events.doc: It entered or left the Ragdoll state.

events.name: MoveToFinished
events.doc: MoveTo arrived (true) or gave up after 8 seconds (false).

events.name: Climbing
events.note: Climbing is not supported; it never fires.
events.doc: It climbed, with its climbing speed.

events.name: Swimming
events.note: Swimming is not supported; it never fires.
events.doc: It swam, with its swimming speed.

classes.name: HumanoidDescription
classes.note: Body colours, scales and animation ids are applied; accessory, clothing, face and body-part asset ids are stored only.
classes.doc: Everything that makes up a character's look: body colours, scales, animations and assets. Humanoid:ApplyDescription applies it.

properties.name: HeightScale
properties.doc: Scales the character's height.

properties.name: WidthScale
properties.doc: Scales the character's width.

properties.name: DepthScale
properties.doc: Scales the character's depth.

properties.name: HeadScale
properties.doc: Scales the head.

properties.name: BodyTypeScale
properties.doc: Blends between body shapes; stored, not applied.

properties.name: ProportionScale
properties.doc: Blends between body proportions; stored, not applied.

properties.name: HeadColor
properties.doc: The colour of the head.

properties.name: TorsoColor
properties.doc: The colour of the torso.

properties.name: LeftArmColor
properties.doc: The colour of the left arm.

properties.name: RightArmColor
properties.doc: The colour of the right arm.

properties.name: LeftLegColor
properties.doc: The colour of the left leg.

properties.name: RightLegColor
properties.doc: The colour of the right leg.

properties.name: IdleAnimation
properties.doc: The id of the idle animation; 0 keeps the default.

properties.name: WalkAnimation
properties.doc: The id of the walk animation; 0 keeps the default.

properties.name: RunAnimation
properties.doc: The id of the run animation; 0 keeps the default.

properties.name: JumpAnimation
properties.doc: The id of the jump animation; 0 keeps the default.

properties.name: FallAnimation
properties.doc: The id of the fall animation; 0 keeps the default.

properties.name: ClimbAnimation
properties.doc: The id of the climb animation; 0 keeps the default.

properties.name: SwimAnimation
properties.doc: The id of the swim animation; 0 keeps the default.

properties.name: Face
properties.doc: The id of the face; stored, not applied.

properties.name: Head
properties.doc: The id of the head mesh; stored, not applied.

properties.name: Torso
properties.doc: The id of the torso mesh; stored, not applied.

properties.name: LeftArm
properties.doc: The id of the left arm mesh; stored, not applied.

properties.name: RightArm
properties.doc: The id of the right arm mesh; stored, not applied.

properties.name: LeftLeg
properties.doc: The id of the left leg mesh; stored, not applied.

properties.name: RightLeg
properties.doc: The id of the right leg mesh; stored, not applied.

properties.name: Shirt
properties.doc: The id of the shirt; stored, not applied.

properties.name: Pants
properties.doc: The id of the pants; stored, not applied.

properties.name: GraphicTShirt
properties.doc: The id of the t-shirt graphic; stored, not applied.

properties.name: HatAccessory
properties.doc: Comma-separated ids of hats; stored, not applied.

properties.name: HairAccessory
properties.doc: Comma-separated ids of hair; stored, not applied.

properties.name: FaceAccessory
properties.doc: Comma-separated ids of face accessories; stored, not applied.

properties.name: NeckAccessory
properties.doc: Comma-separated ids of neck accessories; stored, not applied.

properties.name: ShouldersAccessory
properties.doc: Comma-separated ids of shoulder accessories; stored, not applied.

properties.name: FrontAccessory
properties.doc: Comma-separated ids of front accessories; stored, not applied.

properties.name: BackAccessory
properties.doc: Comma-separated ids of back accessories; stored, not applied.

properties.name: WaistAccessory
properties.doc: Comma-separated ids of waist accessories; stored, not applied.

methods.name: CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription
methods.note: Body colours and scales are applied; asset ids (clothing, accessories, meshes) are not loaded. Returns nil while the part classes are not loaded.
methods.doc: Builds a new character model, not parented, with a Humanoid dressed in the description.

methods.name: GetHumanoidDescriptionFromUserId
methods.note: Offline there is no avatar to read: returns a default description with an RE9203 warning.
methods.doc: The description of a user's avatar.
